title: Classes list stops flagging missing BPM; the builder track panel keeps it
acceptance: The Classes row no longer shows "no BPM set" in the caution channel; missing tempo does not read like a gap that needs action on the list.
The builder track panel still shows which tracks have no BPM.

Design system 10 §1a is checked and still holds: it requires missing tempo as readiness in the builder (the tempo dimension of the readiness panel) and as supporting status in Live; it says nothing about the Classes list, so removing the Classes flag needs no canon change.
GetSongBPM stays unprovisioned (owner deferral); no Spotify BPM path (permanent constraint).

evidence.summary: RF-131 decision 3 (b), owner 2026-10-31; the §1a conflict was found in the conductor's adversarial check.
Final review of #677 corrected file pointers, record links and the design system 10 §1a reading.

Owner set Ready 2026-10-31: approved in the Air session ("Corrected plan is approved", relayed by the Air conductor) and confirmed in the Neo session ("Yes, start the lanes"). Started after RF-133 merged (#680, a1b971d) as planned.

class-ordering.ts classNextStep skips the tempo dimension when naming the next step, so a class whose only gap is missing BPM is "Ready to teach" on the Classes row and in the Live queue order; library-shell.ts drops the "Needs tempo" label. The builder keeps tempo: readiness.ts tempo dimension (readiness panel) and the ClassHeaderCard "no BPM set" status are unchanged; Live per-cue status unchanged (RF-168 is the owner decision there). No GetSongBPM or Spotify BPM path added.

Fail on main a1b971d, pass on the PR: a tempo-only class reads Ready with no dot (ClassesHome.test.tsx) and classNextStep does not make missing tempo a step (class-ordering.test.ts). Tests that used "Needs tempo" as the example label now use "Needs cues". Full local gate green 2026-10-31: web 1614, api 636, e2e 2 passed.

Design system 10 §1a checked on 2026-10-31: missing tempo is readiness in the builder readiness panel and supporting status in Live, and never blocks a run; it says nothing about the Classes list. Still holds; no canon change.

Final review (/code-review medium 682): the refine detail count still included tempo ("2 left" for a class missing cues and BPM); fixed in this PR to count only the gaps the list names, with a test. ClassNextStep.teachable documented as not fullyReady. Logged, not changed: a tempo-only class reads Ready on Classes while its Live queue card says "1 thing left"; Live keeps tempo per design system 10 §1a, and RF-168 holds the owner decision on Live tempo status.

resolution: The Classes list no longer flags missing tempo (#682); the builder readiness panel and Live keep it per design system 10 §1a.
